name: AE (Part-2) Durga Puja
description: Before the puja ground.. this is a play ground for the citizens. Everyday the park opens form 7:00a.m. - 8:30p.m. mainly playing games are football, no cricket peach.  Although can play cricket at afternoon time.  A kids park is also available beside this playground,  those stuff are well maintained.  There is many benches.  There is a water storage , you may refill your bottle any time. For playing, gossiping, relaxing and clicking photoshot a very good place . And at the year ending the durga puja, thats add another fathere on cap. Durga puja may looks crowd full , but those are well deserved things as per the puja . Love this park..

name: AH Block Durga Puja Ground
description:
1. Small budget basic durga puja with simple pandal
2. Not crowded
3. Not recommended to visit if you are looking for outstanding theme pujas-k-no

name: BD BLOCK PARK
description: It is very good and well maintained ground. Pretty active as well for hosting various occasions and sporting events. Ample space for people to sit and chat as well. A good locality Durga Puja too is hosted on this ground. The attached auditorium and BD School also are popular all over saltlake.

name: BF Block Durga Puja Mandap
description:
1. It's a small theme based puja with limited budget
2. If you are pandal hopping within salt lake and don't mind to visit small pujas, then it's a worth to try
3. Don't expect wonder in theme due to small budget

name: BJ Block Durga Puja
description:
Stepping into the mystical realm of Salt Lake BJ Block Durga Puja was like embarking on an enchanting journey where tradition met innovation, leaving me utterly captivated and awestruck. The star of the show, without a doubt, was the resplendent Durga Idol. It was not merely a sculpture; it was a living embodiment of artistry and devotion. The idol's divine aura was palpable, and its intricate detailing was a testament to the unwavering commitment of the artisans who brought it to life.

What truly transported me to a world of wonder was the Adi Yogi 3D Light Show at the pandal. It was as if I had been whisked away into the very tapestry of Hindu mythology. The pandal came alive with a breathtaking symphony of colors, and the Adi Yogi himself seemed to materialize before my eyes. The precision of the projection mapping was nothing short of magical, making me feel like an integral part of Lord Shiva's cosmic dance.

name: CF Block Residents' Association Durga Puja Pandal
description: With my little knowledge about this spot, I must say, if I asked to comment, that the CF residents community centre is uniquely located, on the northern side of it there are a large number of standard eateries at the same time on the southern side there are all office complexes like cgo complex, bikash bhavan, purto bhavan, nagarayan bhavan and top of all bidhan Nagar police station north. What else you want.

name: DL Park
description:
If you are walking towards Tank No. 10 in Salt Lake, you have to cross the road and there is this Park, DL Block Park. It is very well maintained and a good place to just sit and relax. Excellent for.morning and evening walks or just sitting and chatting away at the benches provided.
Every year they organise and celebrate Durga Puja here inside this park. Creative and beautiful Pandal will amaze you.

name: Labony Estate Durga Puja
description: Nice puja inside the Labony estate. You can get auto from Karunamoyee or Ksnkurgachi. Budes are also available .

name: EC Block Park
description: Was going towards FD Block Durga Puja in between found this EC Block Puja. Didn't expect this one to be that pretty. Came as a Suprise I must say. Very nice. Must Visit.

name: Durga Puja, Karunamoyee Housing Estate G Block
description: Avarage in terms of housing estate 3th floor including ground floor. Quite good place no noise.

name: EE Block Ground
description: Well maintained play ground for every sports enthusiasts person. Every year Goalzzz football tournament organised here.

name: DURGA PUJO, FE BLOCK
description:

2. They try to do theme based durga puja even in the small budget
